create_image_processor: create an ImgprocModelImageProcessor with custom resize size, resampling filter, and normalization parameters
resize_image: resize a numpy image array to specified height and width with configurable resampling filter
preprocess_images: preprocess a batch of images with resize, rescale, normalize, and RGB conversion pipeline
build_image_pipeline: build an image preprocessing pipeline using ImgprocModelImageProcessor with OpenAI CLIP mean and std
test_image_processor: test the ImgprocModelImageProcessor preprocess method with PIL images and return torch tensors
